prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Backup Safety Note: Displays explicit reassurance text on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in saves their desktop pet safely to their account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Sign in to safely back up your desktop pet and sync your companion across all your devices.", "hint": "Your pet choices and progress will be automatically saved to your account."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Full Bleed Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen with a full-bleed layout and prominent path option cards to speed up selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Pet Journey", "body": "Select how you would like to bring your desktop pet to life today."}}
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Adds a clear hint on the photo upload screen advising users on lighting and pose for optimal pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload well-lit, clear front-facing photos to ensure your custom pet generates accurately."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Mascot Audio Feedback Flow: Adds visual mascot animations, sound effects, and time estimates to the waiting screen during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_loading", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:chirp_sound", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Compact Controls Overview: Switches home_intro to a compact layout detailing how to control, minimize, and talk to the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, talk, or hide it."}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pick Friend Preview Stage Flow: Upgrades the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and sound clips.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_interactive", "style": "large"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_happy_sound", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Connection Trouble Hint: Adds a diagnostic hint to the sign-in screen to assist users if the sign-in prompt stalls or fails to render.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Stuck on this screen? Check your internet connection or retry signing in."}}
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Intro Preview Screen: Inserts a short dedicated introduction screen before path selection to set clear expectations about desktop pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_intro": {"headline": "Discover Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Prepare to adopt a virtual companion that lives and plays directly on your workspace.", "button_label": "Get Started", "layout": "centered"}}
8: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two Column Seal Redesign: Rebuilds the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout with an official seal badge replacement.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Give your new desktop companion a name to complete the adoption process.", "replace": {"official_stamp": [{"role": "official_stamp", "type": "badge", "asset": "asset:official_seal", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
9: [finish, notification] Home Desktop Readiness Notification: Enables a ready notification trigger and hint guiding users to check their system taskbar once setup completes.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Look for your pet's system tray or menu bar icon if the companion doesn't appear on screen immediately."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds reassuring sign-in copy without violating any onboarding rules.
Redesigns choose path layout while keeping its required function intact.
Adds helpful guidance hint to the photo upload screen.
Enhances the waiting screen with visual feedback and a real wait time estimate.
Updates home_intro layout and controls description within onboarding bounds.
Upgrades pick_friend screen layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Adds diagnostic hint to help users stuck during sign in.
Adds a new introductory screen before path selection without removing any required steps.
Redesigns adoption certificate while preserving the official stamp/seal requirement.
Adds readiness notification and guidance hint to home_intro.
